name: veterinary_clinic_system_066_owner_contact_normalization
instruction:
The practice is migrating to an SMS gateway. Normalize every owner's contact data and run a contact-quality audit.

1. For every owner, rewrite phone to E.164-ish digits-only form: strip all non-digits, then prepend '+1' followed by the last 10 digits (if fewer than 10 digits, prepend '+1' followed by whatever remains). Lowercase every owner's email. Set contact_normalized='<batch_code>' on every owner row, even rows already compliant. Do not change names, addresses, or balances.
2. Create one ops_reports row report='contact_normalization_summary', batch_code, total_owners, normalized_count, duplicate_phone_count, missing_email_count.
3. For every owner whose normalized phone collides with another owner (same normalized number, different owner id), push a reminder_queue row kind='contact_reconcile', status='queued', owner_id set, message 'Duplicate phone <phone> with owners <sorted-owner-ids> - batch <batch_code>', queued_by='system', queued_at the episode timestamp.
4. Push one audit_log row: action='OWNER_CONTACT_NORMALIZED', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='owners', target_id='batch', details='Batch <batch_code> - normalized <N> owner contacts, <D> duplicate phones', occurred_at the episode timestamp.

Do not merge or delete owners. All changes must be keyed by the live batch code.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session

success_criteria.summary: Every owner row has phone '+1' + last 10 stripped digits, email lowercased, contact_normalized=batch. ops_reports has exactly one contact_normalization_summary row with counts matching live data. reminder_queue has exactly one contact_reconcile row per duplicate owner. audit_log has at least one OWNER_CONTACT_NORMALIZED row for the batch. All other owner data unchanged.

checks.expect: exact normalized phone/email and contact_normalized tag on all 220 owners
total, duplicate, and missing counts agree between Python filter and SQL COUNT

hazards: All 220 owner phone values contain non-digit characters (parentheses, spaces, hyphens), e.g. owner 1 '(828) 555-0101' and owner 100 '(828) 555-1099'. A solution that skips rows it thinks are 'already clean' would leave at least some rows unchanged.

Owners 1 (Margaret Whitfield) and 22 (Faye Lovelace) both have phone '(828) 555-0101', so their normalized phone is identical '+18285550101'. These are two distinct owners; the task is to flag the collision, not to merge or delete either.
Every owner has a non-empty email, so missing_email_count must be 0. A solution that invents a missing count based on blanks will fail.

The normalization must use the last 10 digits of the stripped number, not the first. With these 10-digit US numbers the result is the same, but a country-code mistake would break if any seed added a leading '1'.
